text:
maria-chen: Quick check — we're changing the /v2/generate response to drop the top-level `meta` wrapper and return a compact object with fields {id, model, output}. Can older clients handle that? Some SDKs currently expect data.meta.request_id.

alex_k: If SDK reads meta.* directly we'll break. Which clients are we worried about — node & python?

maria-chen: Mainly node SDK 1.x used by our web apps; python 0.9 is pretty tolerant. Thinking we can ship compact top-level but keep meta as an alias for a few months. Thoughts?

jamal: Can we keep meta for a deprecation window? Server-side copy is trivial. Also we should add a header so clients can detect new shape.

alex_k: copying is cheap. Concern: streaming NDJSON clients that parse chunk-by-chunk may have assumptions about key order/size. Need streaming team check.

olivia: forwarding to eng-runtime streaming leads. @sre-bot do we have telemetry that shows which client versions are connecting for streaming endpoints?

sre-bot: deploy-metrics: 12,431 active streaming connections across regions. Logged UA strings but we don't reliably map to SDK versions. Recommend canary + feature header `X-Response-Shape: compact-v2`.

pm-ryan: Timeline constraint — product wants compact shape by end of sprint. Is that realistic if we need SDK patches + deprecation window?

jamal: Server change: add top-level fields and copy existing meta for compatibility. Docs + SDK patches: small. I'll open PR and coordinate canary rollout.

alex_k: I'll add a compatibility shim in node SDK to read top-level first then fallback to meta.*; will push a patch today. Also agree to support header detection.

maria-chen: Great. Can we also add OpenAPI note and a sample response snippet? Example we plan to return:

```json
{
  "id": "req_abc123",
  "model": "redwood-alpha-1",
  "output": { "text": "..." },
  "meta": { "request_id": "req_abc123", "duration_ms": 72 }  // deprecated alias
}
```

olivia: please add a test that validates NDJSON streaming chunks still include `meta` when the canary header isn't present.

jamal: will do. PR #4321 — server + docs + canary header. Adding test and canary rollout plan in the PR description.

maria-chen: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the release notes and coordinate API deprecation email to integrators.

alex_k: ping me if anything blocks SDK release, otherwise I'll merge the shim once Jenkins passes.

pm-ryan: keeping on roadmap. Good to move forward.
